title: Capacity Planning Engineering Supervisor – Stamping Center

cond_0001.intro: First-level supervisor of a group of manufacturing engineers engaged in developing stamping manufacturing plants, equipment/tooling alternatives, sequence and flow of operations for the effective utilization of personnel, material, machines, containers and facilities necessary for the cost-effective production of parts. You will work cross-functionally across operations, containers, purchasing, labor relations, and engineering to optimize [Company name masked]'s manufacturing competitiveness and manufacturing cost per unit (MCPU).
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Evaluates sheet metal allocations
Monitors and balances stamping utilization
Develops, analyzes and presents project information
Provides information for various management systems
Coordinates implementation of projects
Develops programs for effective cost control
Conducts special cost & capacity studies
Recommends new methods of operation and work standards
Optimizes use of floor space, materials, personnel, and equipment
Assists in planning facilities and operations
Leads coordination of reallocations and factory assist
Work will involve managing day to day activities of a team of engineers, including setting objectives, managing results, and evaluating/coaching individual performance.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
10+ Years of professional experience supporting stamping manufacturing strategies for production, maintenance, and tool and die.
10+ Years of professional experience supporting vehicle manufacturing and an in depth understanding of stamping processes including their impact on stamping operations safety and efficiency.
Preferred Requirements
Leadership experience including staffing, evaluation, and ongoing organizational development.
Excellent communication skills to simplify complex technical issues for diverse audiences, including non-technical stakeholders and Senior Leadership.

cond_0631.responsibilities:
Evaluates sheet metal allocations
Monitors and balances stamping utilization
Develops, analyzes and presents project information
Provides information for various management systems
Coordinates implementation of projects
Develops programs for effective cost control
Conducts special cost & capacity studies
Recommends new methods of operation and work standards
Optimizes use of floor space, materials, personnel, and equipment
Assists in planning facilities and operations
Leads coordination of reallocations and factory assist
Work will involve managing day to day activities of a team of engineers, including setting objectives, managing results, and evaluating/coaching individual performance.
cond_0631.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
10+ Years of professional experience supporting stamping manufacturing strategies for production, maintenance, and tool and die.
10+ Years of professional experience supporting vehicle manufacturing and an in depth understanding of stamping processes including their impact on stamping operations safety and efficiency.
Preferred Requirements
Leadership experience including staffing, evaluation, and ongoing organizational development.
Excellent communication skills to simplify complex technical issues for diverse audiences, including non-technical stakeholders and Senior Leadership.
